text:
tyler: starting a canary for api-service -> chart bump 1.12.0 -> 1.13.0, image app:v2.5.0. Initial traffic 12% for 12m
deploy-bot: canary initiated • route=api-prod • weight=12% • duration=12m
maya: check that canary-values.yaml includes db.connMax=60 and poolTimeout=30s. we intentionally increased pool size for burst handling
alex: confirmed file at eng-releases/helm/overrides/api/canary-values.yaml, pinned chart.lock present. I ran `helm dependency list` and saw no changes to subcharts
sre-oncall: rollback policy proposal: immediate rollback if error-rate >4% sustained for 4m OR p95 latency >1.8x baseline for 3m. also rollback on readiness probe flaps (>5 fails per pod in 2m)
tyler: add saturation-specific rule: if active connections per pod exceed 85% of db.connMax for 3m -> rollback candidate
opsbot: canary update: 3m elapsed, errors 0.8% (3/370), p95 115ms (+6%), active_conns mean 34 (target 60)
maya: note: we are not doing a DB migration. pre-upgrade hooks are disabled. only a configmap rename in app code (no heavy ops)
alex: helm command used in CI: `helm upgrade --install api-service charts/api-service --namespace prod --version 1.13.0 -f canary-values.yaml --wait --timeout 8m`
tyler: traffic split via ingress weighted rules + cluster ipset patch. I applied ingress patch: `kubectl -n prod patch ingress api-ingress --type='json' -p='[ ... ]'` (internal details omitted)
deploy-bot: canary pods scaling: replicas 2->4, new pods starting -> 2 ready
sre-oncall: observability note: use short windows for canary: alerts use 1m evaluation for errors and latency (sre-alerts:canary-fast). also add a DB metric tile: `pg_active_connections{app="api-service"}`
maya: adding telemetry meta to pod annotations so traces are grouped by canary-run-id. will update canary-values with `tracing.canaryId`
alex: chart.lock was generated by CI artifact job: release-artifacts/chart-locks/api-service-1.13.0.lock. double-checked content hash matches chart tarball
tyler: if the canary is green at 12m we will step to 50% for 8m then promote to 100% and run final helm release with stable-values.yaml
opsbot: 8m check: errors 1.1% (8/720), p95 132ms (+12%). conn saturation still low, no DB pressure seen
sre-oncall: still within thresholds. be cautious on the 50% jump — pre-warm DB pools if needed or stagger the ingress change across nodes
maya: reminder to post release notes to #release-notes with CHANGELOG link and runbook excerpt. also update incident playbook with the rollback snippet
alex: rollback snippet (for runbook): `kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/api-deployment --to-revision=$(kubectl -n prod rollout history deployment/api-deployment | tail -n +2 | head -n1 | awk '{print $1}')` then pin chart back to 1.12.0 in release registry and trigger hotfix pipeline
tyler: emergency plan: abort before the 50% bump if any of the saturation/latency criteria cross. after 50% we tighten windows to 2m for error-rate detection
deploy-bot: scheduled bump: 50% at +12m. automated checks and canary-fast alerts enabled
opsbot: during bump: traffic rebalanced across 6 pods, small surge in p95 to 150ms but stabilized in 90s
sre-oncall: observed brief 502 spike (15 errors within 1m) — below rollback threshold but flagged. increasing visibility to pager if it repeats
maya: I've added an ad-hoc dashboard comparing canary vs baseline by route and DB connections. link: https://grafana.example/redwood/d/abc123/canary-compare
alex: if we exceed rollback thresholds: undo deployment, rollback chart version in artifact store, and open a hotfix branch. commands for pin: `helm upgrade --install api-service charts/api-service --namespace prod --version 1.12.0 -f stable-values.yaml`
tyler: wrap-up: if 50% remains stable for 8m we promote to 100% and close the canary. I'll draft release notes and attach CHANGELOG diff. standing by for manual rollback :eyes:
deploy-bot: canary stage complete (12% -> healthy) • next: 50% traffic bump scheduled • thread locked for edits
alex: final ops note — remember to update chart annotations with `app.kubernetes.io/version: 1.13.0` in the released chart so CD systems pick it up
sre-oncall: will monitor for 30m post-promotion. set alerts to escalate on repeat 502 spikes
maya: I'll post the runbook and checklist after final promotion, plus a short blameless notes doc for the change
tyler: thanks everyone. let's keep the channel quiet unless we need action :thumbsup:
